top_signals.title: Fed Rate Hike to Be One and Done, Says Citi’s Hollenhorst
top_signals.summary: “It’s hard to make a strong case for a rate hike in this environment,” says Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi. "I just don't see the momentum in the data for further hikes here," he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Hike
top_signals.summary: Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest in almost two decades will continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: UK tech scale-ups raise £3.4bn as Burnham faces test over British investment
top_signals.summary: Britain’s latest crop of high-growth tech companies have raised £3.4bn between them and employ more than 6,000 people, as Andy Burnham faces pressure to get more British capital behind home-grown firms.
